note: Design-owner data for the first homestead (Spec 576 S1). Metres, slab-local frame: x and z are measured from the slab centre, which sits on the engine's flat pad at the world origin. Every number here is a draft default; edit and relaunch, the generator re-places everything.
taste_defaults: colors.scorch: how dark the burn rings read against the slab
scorch_rings[].width_m: how heavy each ring is
colors.hull and colors.emblem: the Empire livery of the pod
slab.half_x_m and slab.half_z_m: pad size against the clearing (4 to 5 m)
pod.door_open_deg: how far the door stands open
pod.door_base_deg and pod.yaw_jitter_deg: where the pod faces and how much it varies per colonist
